description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and check functions for different hardware boards. It manages image verification, upgrade procedures via NAND, emmc, or other methods, and includes conditional logic based on board names. It also handles copying configuration data specific to certain platforms.
external_files: tools like ubiformat, nand_find_ubi, nand_find_volume, ubiro, fw_printenv, fw_setenv, mtd, find_mtd_index, tar, ubiformat

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the presence of certain partitions or conditions before upgrading, specific to board types.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade for certain Askey devices by extracting and writing the root filesystem from a tar archive.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles Zyxel-specific upgrade procedures, extracting kernel and root partitions from a tar archive.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that chooses the appropriate upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies platform-specific configuration data during upgrade for certain platforms.
